headline: Markets eye WPI inflation and FII activity as analysts review top stock Q2 earnings

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: WPI inflation, crude oil prices, and FII trading activity are key factors expected to guide stock markets this week.
Indian stock markets extended gains for a third straight week backed by foreign institutional investor (FII) buying.
Brokerages are releasing Q2 review reports, impacting sentiment on individual stocks following earnings announcements.
Investors remain attentive to both broad-based Q2 beats and downgrades in key sectors.
whatHappening: Motilal Oswal selected Bharat Electronics and Dixon Tech among top stock picks after broad-based Q2 earnings beats.
Tata Motors faced target price cuts from Jefferies, Goldman Sachs, and Kotak, with up to a 45% EPS downgrade.
Grasim Industries received a mixed outlook with 5 bullish ratings alongside 3 target cuts from analysts.
IPO activity and overall market trends continue to see cautious optimism from market experts.
summary: Indian markets enter the new week having logged a third straight weekly gain, driven by FII buying. Investors are tracking upcoming WPI inflation data and global market signals. Post-Q2 earnings reviews are driving stock-specific action in names like Tata Motors, Grasim, Bharat Electronics, and Dixon Tech.
